build_backbone_resnet: build a ResNet backbone with a custom BasicStem and configurable depth from an omegaconf config
create_basic_stem: create a BasicStem convolutional module with optional caffe-style max pooling for feature extraction
run_generalized_rcnn_inference: run inference on images through a GeneralizedRCNN to extract pooled RoI features from proposal boxes
build_generalized_rcnn: build a GeneralizedRCNN model with a backbone, RPN proposal generator, and Res5 RoI heads from config
forward_roi_head_features: forward features and proposal boxes through the RoI head to get pooled feature vectors
